capabilities: Teach Vim through 82 short lessons in a tab
Practise on a copy of a note or a selection
Review learned commands in a two-minute daily session
Offer a daily Vim golf puzzle and generated drills
Toggle common Vim key mappings and Obsidian's Vim key bindings
disambiguation: Not a Vim engine or key-binding replacement; it is a course and practice tool that runs on Obsidian's existing Vim mode.
extras: Closed source; the free lessons, daily review, golf, note practice and Vim keys need no account, while the rest of the course and Pro drills need a paid vimninja.com account. Desktop only, Obsidian 1.13 or later, and no default hotkeys are set.
intentEvidence: VimNinja is the rest: the motions, text objects, counts, registers and macros
motivation: The author wanted the rest of Vim after the key bindings are switched on, learned a few minutes at a time on a real Vim engine without leaving the vault.
problem: Turning on Obsidian's Vim key bindings leaves most people with a block cursor and Esc, with no way inside the vault to learn motions, text objects, counts, registers or macros.
summary: Vim course and practice tab for Obsidian with 82 short lessons, a two-minute daily review, Vim golf, and practice on a copy of your own notes.
